DISCUSS: What Happened in College Football Saturday: Gators Take Down No. 4 Ole Miss as Top 25 Shakes
Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28 to move to 4-0, while Wisconsin and Wake Forest pulled road upsets and No. 1 Texas and No. 2 Georgia stayed unbeaten ahead of Sunday's AP poll.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/college-football-saturday-week-4-wrap-gators-ole-miss-top-25
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
